## Summary
Chain/transaction design, environment and secret-handling boundary. Fixed chain/asset/destination model, isolated signer interface, zero secrets committed.

## Owner Role
Lead / akiibot. A single PR author owns this outcome. Required reviewer: lead for schemas, migrations, authorization, signing or execution; another developer for all PRs.

## Dependencies
None; lead-owned foundation work.
Foundation branch exists locally; do not close until reviewed and integrated.

## Paths Owned
- `services/api/app/execution/interfaces.py`
- `.env.example`
- `docs/CHAIN.md`
Shared contracts, migrations and app/main.py are lead-owned. Request a separate contract-change PR for changes; regenerate OpenAPI + TypeScript and notify both consuming workstreams.

## API Contract
See contracts/openapi.json, contracts/financial-state.example.json, services/api/app/models/contracts.py and docs/API.md.

Canonical examples: `contracts/financial-state.example.json`, `contracts/action-request.example.json`, `contracts/requests.example.json`. These are shape fixtures, never evidence of live chain configuration or successful verification. Error envelope: `{"code":"NOT_IMPLEMENTED","message":"Feature awaiting implementation","reasons":[]}`. Amounts ending `_minor` are integer USD cents; token base units are decimal strings; probabilities are integer basis points.

## Implementation Tasks
- [ ] Fixed chain/asset/destination model, isolated signer interface, zero secrets committed.
- [ ] Review the foundation implementation and attach verification evidence before closing.
- [ ] Read AGENTS.md, docs/ARCHITECTURE.md, docs/DECISIONS.md and current contracts before editing.
- [ ] Add focused tests in `services/api/tests/test_foundation.py` and update progress/evidence.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Fixed chain/asset/destination model, isolated signer interface, zero secrets committed.
- [ ] Missing dependencies and malformed input fail explicitly; no fabricated PASS, approval, certificate, risk metric or tx hash.
- [ ] Actual routes integrate with current main and generated client; behavior is demonstrated in API/browser output where relevant.
- [ ] Relevant edge/failure/boundary tests pass, alongside the existing browser-to-database smoke test.

## Test Commands
`.venv/bin/python -m pytest services/api/tests/test_foundation.py -q` (existing foundation tests must pass).
`npm run check` (backend tests + lint, contract generation, frontend lint/typecheck/build and real browser/API smoke).
For chain outcomes: attach a real Base Sepolia receipt + explorer link separately; mocked adapters are CI evidence only.

## Evidence / Notes
Status: IMPLEMENTED_PENDING_REVIEW. GitHub publication mapping is maintained in docs/ISSUE_BACKLOG.md.
Attach PR URL, commit SHA, exact commands/results and relevant screenshots/trace. Do not expose keys, RPC credentials, cookies or tokens.

## Definition of Done
Reviewed issue-linked PR merged with passing CI and integration evidence; dependent issue statuses updated. A code stub or fixture does not complete a feature.

## Out of scope
New scenarios, mainnet/real money, production custody, duplicate schemas, unrelated rewrites, or changes to approved architecture.
